candidateSetModel.note: Approximation of IndexedWords.internalLink bucket sizes for the internal-link provider (basenames + frontmatter aliases, synonym forms excluded). Real bucket also depends on path/tag/frontmatter exclusion settings and on alias-vs-basename mode.

typingRisk.note: Command-only.

typingRisk.note: Settings modal only.

typingRisk.note: Invoked explicitly.

typingRisk.label: Full file-tree re-render on vault events
typingRisk.note: Re-renders a large tree on create/rename/delete; matters on 10k+ note vaults, not per keystroke.

typingRisk.label: Footnote autocomplete
typingRisk.note: Registered suggestion provider; competes with other EditorSuggests but cheap.

typingRisk.label: CSS-only UI hiding
typingRisk.note: Style-level; negligible.

typingRisk.label: Form modal rendering
typingRisk.note: Modal-only.

typingRisk.label: Related-notes pane
typingRisk.note: Queries link graph when the pane is open; can be O(vault) if it re-scans.

typingRisk.label: Per-keystroke CM6 decorations
typingRisk.note: Heading stickiness recomputes viewport decorations on scroll/typing; can multiply editor layout work in long chapters.

typingRisk.label: Plugin toggle shortcuts
typingRisk.note: Command-only.

typingRisk.note: Suggestion overlays and macro execution; mostly idle while typing prose, but macro captures can run on save.

typingRisk.note: Typewriter Mode runs cursor-centering and dimming on every keystroke/selection change; it competes for the same frame budget as EditorSuggest.

typingRisk.label: Quick switcher fork
typingRisk.note: Indexes on demand when invoked; can re-scan on open.

typingRisk.label: Per-node icon lookups
typingRisk.note: Cheap per-node, but multiplies file-explorer render cost on big trees.

limitations: No live keystroke instrumentation: this script never runs inside Obsidian and cannot measure in-app suggest latency.
mtime is the last *save* time (Obsidian autosave ~2s), not the time words were typed. Per-day counts and session bursts describe save activity, not actual typing duration.
A burst's estimatedWordsTouched is the sum of the whole files' word counts at scan time — editing one line of a 3,000-word chapter counts as 3,000 words touched.
A file saved twice in the window appears once (only the final mtime survives), so bursts may undercount re-edits.
Word counts are whitespace-delimited tokens over the body (frontmatter stripped). CJK text without spaces undercounts; totalCjkChars is reported separately.
Link resolution is not performed: without Obsidian's metadataCache we cannot tell resolved targets from unresolved (phantom) links. Both are counted.
Aliases are parsed with a YAML subset parser (inline lists, comma lists, block lists). Exotic YAML (anchors, multiline scalars) is not supported.
Files are read from disk, not from Obsidian's index, so ignore-filters (excluded folders, .trash, .smart-env) are NOT applied beyond .obsidian/.git/node_modules.
Scan results reflect disk state at scan time; Obsidian may hold unsaved buffer changes.
